rules: Keep NOVA's face, hairstyle, glasses and body proportions consistent.
Use the same palette: black, cream and muted cobalt.
Choose one primary prop per shot.
Do not introduce logos or recognizable brands.
Do not change age, identity or physical characteristics between episodes.
